collection: CrossPet original character pose assets and local supplements
purpose: Public non-commercial Hana Desk Pet demo runtime integration; commercial use is prohibited.

upstream.codeLicenseNote: The upstream root MIT license expressly covers source code only; it does not cover these character images.

assetHandling.format: The 193 upstream WebP files are unchanged byte-for-byte; four locally AI-generated supplements are identified per character and are not upstream files.
assetHandling.generatedAssetPolicy: claude/drawing.webp, gemini/idle-blink.webp, deepseek-hoodie/idle-2.webp, and deepseek-hoodie/idle-3.webp are local AI-generated supplements, not CrossPet originals or works attributable to an upstream artist; they are used under the same CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 terms.
excluded: Upstream character.json files (including lines and app bindings)
Generation prompts, source code, integrations, Easter-egg characters, greetings, and seasonal poses
Pose files not listed under an item below

characters.name: Claude
characters.designCredit: CrossPet's AI-generated rendition of the community-popular Claude-girl design (copper/orange hair, orange-flower ornament, book). Upstream does not identify an individual illustrator or the original design author; its license lists ai-school-op and openpet-ai-girls as references, not as a verified direct source for this exact image.

characters.name: GPT / white dragon
characters.designCredit: CrossPet's AI-generated rendition of the community design '御姐白龙', credited upstream to ZipZipPipe on Bilibili; the individual source post URL is not listed in the license.

characters.name: DeepSeek / 大肥鱼
characters.designCredit: CrossPet's AI-generated rendition. Upstream credits the '溟月' prototype to 上善无形 (2025-06, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) and the deep-blue maid whale-girl / '大肥鱼' design to ZipZipPipe on Bilibili; no exact source post URL is listed.

characters.name: Gemini
characters.designCredit: CrossPet's AI-generated rendition of a community-popular Gemini-girl design (cat ears, heterochromia, four-point-star ornament). Upstream does not name an individual original author or illustrator; ai-school-op and openpet-ai-girls are listed as references, not as verified direct sources for this exact image.

characters.name: GLM / black fox maid
